description: Retrieval evaluation set for the Nobel Explorer knowledge index. Relevant document ids were defined from the database contents BEFORE any retrieval run. Relevance is judged at the parent document level (doc_id), not chunk level. Each relevant set has at most 5 ids so Recall@5 can reach 1.0.
